items.title: Core: selectNextItem + resetStalledItems
items.description: Add 2 new functions to packages/core/src/backlog.ts: (1) selectNextItem(backlog) — returns the first pending item by priority (lowest number = highest priority) where ALL items in dependsOn have status 'done'. items.title: signal-parser.ts + git-commit.ts
items.description: Create two pure-logic modules in packages/loop/src/. (1) signal-parser.ts: parseSignal(stdout) scans Claude's stdout for exit signals. Checks the last non-empty line for RALPH_DONE, RALPH_BLOCKED:<reason>, or RALPH_NEEDS_HUMAN:<reason>. Returns { signal: 'done' | 'blocked' | 'needs_human' | 'none', reason?: string }. Returns Result with success/failure. Non-fatal on failure (loop continues). Export both from index.ts.

items.title: usage-checker.ts
items.description: Create packages/loop/src/usage-checker.ts that checks Claude API usage limits via the Anthropic OAuth API. Uses the token from core's readClaudeOAuthToken(). Queries GET `https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and required header `anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20`, with a 10-second timeout. Response structure: `{ five_hour: { utilization, resets_at }, seven_day: { utilization, resets_at } }` where utilization is a percentage (0-100+) and resets_at is an ISO timestamp. Returns `{ limited: boolean, limitType?: '5h' | '7d', utilization?: number, retryAfter?: number, resetsAt?: string }`. Also implements `interruptibleSleep(durationMs, abortSignal, onHeartbeat?)` — a sleep that can be cancelled via AbortController signal, checking the signal every ~30 seconds. If onHeartbeat callback is provided, it is called every ~5 minutes during sleep (used by the runner to update state.json updatedAt to prevent staleness detection).

Handles API errors gracefully (network failure, auth error -> assume not limited, log warning)
Unit tests with mocked fetch for limit/no-limit/error scenarios, and heartbeat callback verification
pnpm test && pnpm typecheck passes
items.notes: Ports ralph.sh's check_usage_api (line 294) and sleep_with_cancel (line 335) functions. Uses native fetch() instead of curl. Required header `anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20` per ralph.sh line 299. Response fields five_hour/seven_day parsed at lines 416-418. The 10s timeout matches --max-time 10 at line 300. The heartbeat callback replaces ralph.sh's explicit state.json updatedAt touch every 5 minutes during sleep (lines 355-359), preventing deriveStatus() from marking the loop as stale. items.title: claude-process.ts
items.description: Create packages/loop/src/claude-process.ts that spawns 'claude -p' as a child process. Always passes `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and `--output-format text` flags (required for headless autonomous operation). Pipes the prompt string via stdin, captures stdout and stderr as separate strings. Implements configurable timeout via setTimeout + proc.kill('SIGTERM') → 30s grace period → proc.kill('SIGKILL'). The timeout value comes from options.sessionTimeoutMinutes (converted to ms). Returns { exitCode, stdout, stderr, timedOut, durationMs }. Supports optional --model flag when options.model is specified. Supports external cancellation via AbortController signal.

items.description: Create packages/loop/src/runner.ts implementing the main LoopRunner class. Writes state.json/ralph.log throughout. Uses try/finally to reset in_progress items on crash. Writes DONE file on all exit paths.
